feature: Prompt-cache affinity: promptCacheAffinityEnabled, a combo-only rendezvous-hash account-locality stage
what_it_does: [src] This is a routing stage that runs only inside combos. The key is the explicit body or metadata prompt_cache_key (up to 4096 chars). Without one, the key is 'omni-'+sha256 of the leading system/tool/assistant messages before the first user message. There is no key when the input starts with a user or developer message, and the Responses 'instructions' field is never read (promptCacheAffinity.ts L47-118; prefixAnalyzer.ts L40-80). When a key resolves, each unpinned step is expanded to every active account (L184-271). Accounts are ranked by 0.75 x rendezvous(sha256(key, connection id)) + 0.25 x OAuth availability, where availability = 1/(1+foreign in-flight sessions) (L126-146; oauthSessionOccupancy.ts L35-41). Scope is 'model' for priority/weighted/fill-first/quota-share, which keeps the declared model order, and 'global' for every other strategy (targetResolution.ts L713-726). Round-robin always uses global scope and resets the rotation start to 0 (roundRobinCombo.ts L389-410). Stickiness and auto-router pins keep slot 0 (targetResolution.ts L728-730). The stage is skipped when there is 1 target or when auto has weights.cacheAffinity>0 (L641-662). It never changes body bytes. Quirk: in model scope, a rank equal to the expansion order reports applied=false, and the unexpanded step then goes to credential selection (promptCacheAffinity.ts L380-384; targetResolution.ts L727).
defaults: promptCacheAffinityEnabled=true (settings.ts L163; schema is an optional boolean, settingsSchemas.ts L346-347). [doc] Upstream docs state default true, that the stage takes precedence over round-robin/weighted rotation across pinned steps, and that there is no per-combo override (AUTO-COMBO.md L364-372). The auto scorer's cacheAffinity weight defaults to 0.00 (L207). The cache-optimized strategy always applies affinity (applyStrategyOrdering.ts L224-233).
controls: The only switch is the global setting promptCacheAffinityEnabled (settings API, or UI Settings > Combo defaults > 'Prompt-cache locality routing', ComboDefaultsTab.tsx L707-723). There is no header and no per-combo override. Per-combo levers that act on it anyway: strategy 'cache-optimized' forces it on even when the toggle is false; 'auto' with weights.cacheAffinity>0 moves it into scoring; a single-target combo skips it. On the request side, the client's prompt_cache_key or metadata.prompt_cache_key sets the key. A lane selects the feature only by using a combo model name. Settings that interact: sessionAffinityTtlMs (an active session pin overrides the combo's forced connection, auth.ts L1328-1345, #5903), disableSessionStickiness, connectionAwareExpansion.
applies_to: CX: inactive today. cx/gpt-6-astra and cx/gpt-6-sol are direct provider/model names (cx is the codex alias, registry/codex/index.ts L11), and the direct path never reads the toggle. CX account locality comes from a separate mechanism, the direct 4 h session pin. Its key is taken from x-codex-session-id/x-session-id/x-omniroute-session, then metadata session ids, conversation_id, session_id, prompt_cache_key, then a hash of the first input (sessionAffinityPin.ts L197-222; auth.ts L1965-1997). FW: applies only when a framework's model field names a combo. This is the only class where it could add value, by grouping calls that share a system prompt onto one account. SEARCH: N/A. The search route and the local-only alpha-search route contain no combo reference (rg exit 1).
quality_risk:
Routing only: it never changes content, so a single-model combo cannot degrade output. Risks by routing shape:
(1) Global scope (round-robin, lkgp, cost, auto, cache-optimized) can put another model's account ahead of the declared model. Upstream fixed this only for deterministic strategies (#8370 via #8400 and #9420). A mixed astra/sol combo could therefore serve a judgment request with sol.
(2) For requests with a key, round-robin rotation collapses onto one account (#13370, open). Even a single dynamic step is expanded and ranked (targetResolution.ts L703-706; roundRobinCombo.ts L373-376), so the doc claim that a dynamic step rotates holds only for requests without a key.
(3) Load concentration: the prefix key hashes only the system prompt. A synthetic simulation of the L126-146 scoring (4 accounts, 20,000 keys) moved the winner with p=0.516 at 1 foreign in-flight session, 0.633 at 2 and 0.800 at most, so about 20% of keys stay on one account until a 429/quota failover. An existing session pin overrides the combo's choice (auth.ts L1328-1345).
(4) A general combo cost, not caused by this feature: tool requests fail closed with 400 when the target's toolCalling capability is falsy (comboStructure.ts L617-631).
cache_effect: It does not change the prompt prefix, so it cannot turn cached tokens into uncached ones. It only chooses which account receives a key. [live] No effect on the measured split: 24h cached 91,426,944 of 97,094,617 input (~94%), all traffic 'direct'; cache-health shows 1443 warm and 43 uncached calls out of 1486. Inside a combo it keeps a key on one account. Each winner move from the availability term costs one cold prefix on the new account. With explicit per-conversation keys it matches the direct session pin. With prefix keys it can raise cross-call reuse of a shared system prompt: the codex executor already sends the account-wide workspaceId as prompt_cache_key when the body has no key or session id (codex.ts L1204-1219, L1504-1514).
token_effect: No bytes change and there is no output effect (output is ~1% of tokens). The upside is capped by the uncached input: 5,667,673 tokens in 24h (~6%), partly unavoidable first turns. No gain expected for CX; FW gain unmeasured.
proposed_config:
KEEP, with no write needed (the live value equals the upstream default): promptCacheAffinityEnabled=true, sessionAffinityTtlMs=14400000, disableSessionStickiness=false, connectionAwareExpansion=false, and providerStrategies.codex as is.

DEFAULT PATH: CX keeps cx/gpt-6-astra and cx/gpt-6-sol direct, and FW/SEARCH keep direct model names, so their bytes stay identical.

PER-LANE OPT-IN (FW only, after its A/B; the coordinator performs the POST):
- Create one single-model combo per quality tier, with one plain-string (dynamic-account) step and strategy priority, e.g. POST /api/combos {"name":"fw-gpt6-sol-cache","models":["cx/gpt-6-sol"],"strategy":"priority"}. Create a separate astra combo for judgment. Names are illustrative. Schema: a plain-string entry is allowed and strategy defaults to priority (combo.ts L49-53, L362-370).
- The lane sets model=<combo name>.
- The client sends an explicit per-job or per-thread prompt_cache_key unless the A/B is testing prefix grouping.

NEVER: mix astra and sol in one combo; use round-robin or weighted over pinned per-account steps; use cache-optimized on a multi-model combo; run auto with cacheAffinity>0 alongside this stage.
overturn_condition: Set the toggle to false (OFF-BY-EVIDENCE) if any combo lane's A/B shows lower cacheRead/input, more account switches, or more 429/failover with affinity on than off, or if a lane needs a mixed-model combo under a global-scope strategy. Move CX to a combo only if a measured A/B beats the direct ~94% cached ratio. Re-resolve if upstream adds a per-combo override or changes defaults (#13370), or if release/v3.8.51 moves past a58000c7 and touches promptCacheAffinity.ts, targetResolution.ts or roundRobinCombo.ts.
